{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured blazer with notched lapels, a tailored cut through the waist, navy blue (#000080), wool blend.
Tapered trousers in a matching navy tone, a slim fit that skims the leg without restriction, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy crepe.
A silk blouse with a rounded neckline and subtle gathering at the shoulders, an oversized fit for comfort under the jacket, ivory white (#FFFFF0), raw silk.
Gold hoop earrings with a polished finish, medium gauge to frame the face, gold metal.
A slim leather clutch in a metallic champagne shade, soft rectangular silhouette, patent leather.
Strappy ankle sandals in nude tone, a moderate heel height for stability on uneven dance floors, satin fabric.

This outfit works by balancing the smart dress code with your desire for a relaxed evening celebration. The matching navy blazer and trousers create a polished yet approachable look perfect for a friend's party, while the oversized silk blouse adds a touch of feminine softness and ease to prevent stiffness. Gold accents in the jewelry and shoes introduce warmth that complements the artificial lighting of an autumn evening event. Finally, the choice of stable footwear ensures you can comfortably dance and socialize throughout the night without sacrificing style."}
